parsed.rationale: Both records are `type-alias-object` kinds with empty `fields_or_signature` lists and no structural evidence (Jaccard, shared fields, shared ancestor are all null), meaning the pipeline has only detected a name collision — `RootTabView` — across two distinct app targets (`app:WatchXYC` in `WXYC/WatchXYC/RootTabView.swift` and `app:iOS` in `WXYC/iOS/Views/Root/RootTabView.swift`). These are platform-specific root view types for watchOS and iOS respectively; sharing the same conventional name is idiomatic SwiftUI practice, not accidental duplication. Because the records carry no shared members and live in separate app targets with no dependency relationship, there is nothing to extract or unify without coupling divergent platform UIs.
